summary: Final regression for the FIXED PRC RATE cleanup (June 2026). All 31 new cleanup tests pass plus 33 prior regression tests (10 L1-L5 cascade + 23 referral cleanup). Verified: all rate helpers return fixed 10 (and 0.10 for ledger), GET /api/growth/prc-rate returns the fixed-rate payload, surviving endpoints (mining/rate-breakdown, notifications/level-breakdown, bank-redeem/denominations) still 200, all 14 deleted dynamic-rate endpoints are gone (404/401), all 5 deleted source files no longer exist, server.py contains no live imports/handlers/scheduler hooks for the removed engine, and backend supervisor log shows clean startup with no ImportError / ModuleNotFoundError.

server.py has multiple historical 'admin_prc_economy removed' markers (lines 2935, 12437, 36077). Comments only — fine, but if main agent wants extra tidiness these can be collapsed.
server.py is ~36k lines; far above the 700-line threshold. Not a regression-blocker but a long-standing maintainability concern (already flagged in earlier iterations).
test_credentials: Used test UID fcd8c6f8-9596-4f56-8556-568847d5ab86 as supplied; no auth required for tested endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The dynamic PRC-rate engine has been fully removed. Source of truth is utils.helpers.PRC_INR_RATE = 10 (and 0.10 in admin_accounting.get_prc_ledger_rate). If any future change needs to touch the rate, update only utils/helpers.py. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_fixed_prc_rate_cleanup.py covers: helper return values, /api/growth/prc-rate, deleted endpoints (14), deleted files (5), surviving endpoints, and supervisor log import-error scan. Backend bank-redeem rate is surfaced via /api/bank-redeem/denominations samples (each carries prc_rate field). The originally-requested POST /api/bank-redeem/calculate-fees does NOT exist in the codebase; bank-redeem uses GET /bank-redeem/denominations for fee preview — that's what we asserted against.
rca of the issue: N/A — regression run only.
